title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
abstract: arXiv:2610.12266v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. translated_title: DVD：面向高效多模态大语言模型感知的动态向量解码方法
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型在连接视觉与语言方面取得了显著进展，促进了对人机交互、机器人和自动驾驶至关重要的各类感知任务。然而，现有的基于MLLM的感知方法主要依赖基于文本的坐标表示（存在过大的token开销）或固定范围量化（存在范围和精度的限制），尤其是对于具有无界空间范围和高定位精度要求的3D领域。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为DVD的动态向量解码方法，它统一了2D和3D感知任务的表示。具体而言，我们首先将多样化的感知表示（即2D边界框、2D掩码和3D边界框）转换为1D向量序列，然后将其映射到高维空间中的紧凑离散token，随后通过一个轻量级的解码器……
tldr: 本文提出DVD动态向量解码方法，通过将2D和3D感知表示统一转换为紧凑离散token，解决了现有MLLM感知方法中token开销过大和量化精度受限的问题。
en_tdlr: DVD proposes a dynamic vector decoding method that unifies 2D and 3D perception representations into compact discrete tokens, addressing the excessive token overhead and precision limitations of existing MLLM-based perception methods.
